description: This file contains React hooks and functions for managing CloudZero settings, including fetching, updating, and deleting settings via API calls, utilizing react-query for data fetching and cache management.

methods.name: getCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Fetches CloudZero settings from the API, returning null if not found.

methods.name: useCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: React hook to fetch and cache CloudZero settings using react-query.

methods.name: updateCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Updates CloudZero settings via API with provided parameters.

methods.name: useCloudZeroUpdateSettings
methods.description: React hook to perform and manage CloudZero settings update mutation.

methods.name: useCloudZeroDeleteSettings
methods.description: React hook to perform and manage CloudZero settings deletion mutation.
